title: Maintenance of Children and Aged Parents — Section 20 HAMA

content.overview: Section 20 of the Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act, 1956 obliges a Hindu to maintain his or her legitimate or illegitimate children and aged or infirm parents. A legitimate or illegitimate child may claim so long as the child is a minor; the obligation to aged or infirm parents extends insofar as they are unable to maintain themselves out of their own earnings or property.
content.glance: Ask: (1) Hindu obligor? (2) Child (legitimate/illegitimate) minor? (3) Aged/infirm parent unable to maintain self?
content.study:
s. 20 creates a personal obligation independent of HMA matrimonial proceedings. Quantum is guided by the HAMA scheme (needs, means, status).

Coordinate with CrPC/BNSS maintenance to avoid double recovery.

No case holdings invented. Case-law verification remains a separate gate.
